newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices, volume firm on demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices, volume firm on demand.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange jumped to 1,923 kilos on Wednesday from Tuesday's 915 kilos on physical demand and registration of gold on the market by banks, dealers said.
Gold closed slightly firmer at $342.00 an ounce and 1,488,000 lira per gram compared to $341.00 and 1,484,000 lira on Tuesday, rising with the extra demand, traders said.

"There is some physical demand on the market due to the low prices, even though it is still early for seasonal demand to pick up. On top of that, there was some activity by banks registering gold on the market," one dealer said.
Banks have to register imported gold on the exchange by buying and selling it themselves before they can sell it to non-member traders outside the bourse.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,183 kilos -- took place in the afternoon session, with 51.5 percent of the total traded in dollar terms.
